message:
- Fixed an issue where gold became extremely low regardless of stage
- Equipment damage now scales more smoothly with rarity and item level to prevent extreme progression jumps.
- Trial Dungeon boss difficulty now follows the updated chest progression.
- Monster Gold now scales more strongly after Stage 1,000.
- Fixed attacks occasionally becoming stuck when less than one hit was required.
- The Damage display now shows general damage without including Tap or Idle bonuses.
 - Tuning
 - Bugfixes
